svg.title: TurboVLA inference pipeline on the NexArm
svg.desc: Camera frames, the task instruction and the joint state go in. DINOv3 turns each 224 by 224 view into 196 tokens, a frozen BERT encodes the instruction, and six bi-attention layers let image and text tokens attend to each other. The joint state becomes two tokens. A three-layer decoder with 16 queries predicts 16 actions; the arm runs the first 8 and then looks again.
svg.text: TurboVLA reads the task, then plans 16 steps.
